description: This file defines database interaction functions for 'flashcards' in a backend application, including listing, retrieving by ID, creating, updating, and removing flashcards. It establishes SQL queries and handles data manipulation related to flashcards management.

methods.name: list({ q, categoryId, partOfSpeech, limit = 50, offset = 0 })
methods.description: Retrieves a list of flashcards based on optional search criteria including query string, category ID, and part of speech, with support for pagination.

methods.name: getById(id)
methods.description: Fetches a single flashcard by its ID, throws NotFoundError if not found.

methods.name: create({ indonesian, english, partOfSpeech, exampleSentence, difficulty = 1, categoryId = null })
methods.description: Creates a new flashcard record in the database with specified attributes and retrieves the complete flashcard data after creation.

methods.name: update(id, { indonesian, english, partOfSpeech, exampleSentence, difficulty, categoryId })
methods.description: Updates an existing flashcard by ID with provided attributes, throws NotFoundError if the flashcard does not exist.

methods.name: remove(id)
methods.description: Deletes a flashcard by ID, throws NotFoundError if the flashcard does not exist.

ctags.signature: ({ indonesian, english, partOfSpeech, exampleSentence, difficulty = 1, categoryId = null })
